versions.changelog: Fix: doc token tu file config thay vi $META_ACCESS_TOKEN (env khong reload sau restart); them Buoc 0 kiem tra token ton tai truoc khi doi; them buoc debug_token truoc khi exchange + so khop app_id; bang phan biet loi 190/459/460/client secret; ghi ro KHONG can xin token moi de doi long-lived

**Improved reliability and accuracy for Meta long-lived token exchange.**

- Always reads current token from config file instead of environment variable to prevent silent failures, especially on new machines.
- Stops and prompts if `META_ACCESS_TOKEN` is missing from config, avoiding misleading secret errors.
- Adds validation for App ID and App Secret formats; warns if token belongs to a different app.
- Now checks token validity with `debug_token` before attempting exchange; halts if invalid to save troubleshooting time.
- Clarifies error handling and troubleshooting with an expanded mapping of common Meta API errors.
- Removes outdated file (`skill-card.md`).
Thêm mục KÍCH HOẠT: người dùng chỉ cần nhập 'Em gia hạn token thêm 60 ngày nhé. ID App: ... Secrect key: ...' là skill tự chạy.

- Initial release of meta-long-lived-token skill.
- Converts Meta short-lived user tokens (~1–2h) to long-lived tokens (~60 days) via the official Graph API.
- Checks token validity and expiration, stores safely in gateway environment.
- Provides reminders when token is about to expire and guides for renewal.
- Strictly read-only with ads data; does not modify or delete ad content.
- Includes full security guidance for handling and storing tokens.
